```{r load package}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrain)

```

## Load the processed data

```{r loadData}
#load processed data
h1Data <- read.csv("DATA/processed_data/CLAProject_h1.csv")
h2Data <- read.csv ("DATA/processed_data/CLAProject_h2.csv")

View(h1Data)
View(h2Data)


#reorganize categorical variable
table(h1Data$cot_educ)
h1Data$cot_educ <- factor(h1Data$cot_educ,
                           levels = c("None","Primary","Secondary", "High school/technical college", "Bachelor", "Master", "PhD/MD/JD or equivalent"))



```

## H1 - Box Plot

```{r H1Box}
#Box plot
#The line is the median; the box covers the middle 50% of responses (Q1-Q3).
#Whiskers reach the most extreme observations within 1.5 IQR of the box edges.

h1Box <- ggplot(data=h1Data,
                aes(x=cot_educ,
                    y=geneqavg,
                    fill=cot_educ))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  labs(x="Educational Attainment",
       y="Attitude Towards Gender Equality",
       title="Relationship between Educational Attainment and Gender Equality Attitude",
       fill = "Education")+
  theme_gray(base_size = 8)
  
h1Box

## Can use theme_gray for gray background 
### if do fill = "" - will make it so there's no legend 

```

## H1 - Violin Plot (with Box Plot)

```{r H1Violin}
#Violin Plot
#Wider sections show where responses are more concentrated within each group.
#The shape depends on smoothing; integer scores can create bumps.

h1Viol <- ggplot(data=h1Data,
                aes(x=cot_educ,
                    y=geneqavg,
                    fill=cot_educ))+
  labs(x="Educational Attainment",
       y="Attitude Towards Gender Equality",
       title="Relationship between Educational Attainment and Gender Equality Attitude",
       fill = "Education")+
  theme_gray(base_size = 8)+
  geom_violin()+
  geom_boxplot(width=.12)
            ###Have to list violin 1st & boxplot 2nd or wont show up
h1Viol

```

## H1 - Raincloud Plot

```{r H1Raincloud}
#Raincloud Plot
#A raincloud combines a half-violin, a box plot, and individual responses.

h1Rain <- ggplot(data=h1Data,
                aes(x=cot_educ,
                    y=geneqavg,
                    fill=cot_educ))+
  labs(x="Educational Attainment",
       y="Attitude Towards Gender Equality",
       title="Relationship between Educational Attainment and Gender Equality Attitude",
       fill = "Education")+
  theme_gray(base_size = 6)+
  geom_rain(alpha=.5)
    ###alpha makes the figures slightly opaque
  
h1Rain
  
```

## H2 - Scatter Plots

```{r H2Scatter}
#Scatter Plot
table(data$commitmentavg)
table(data$attractimp)
h2point <- ggplot(data=h2Data,
                aes(x=commitmentavg,
                    y=attractimp,
                    fill=commitmentavg))+
  geom_point()+
  labs(x="Confidence/Security in Relationship",
       y="Importance of Looking Attractive",
       title="Relationship between Security in Relationship and Importance of Looking Attractive")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) 

h2point

  

#Plot looks weird... why? - all on top of eachother
nrow(h2Data)
nrow(unique(h2Data[,c("commitmentavg","attractimp")]))


#Jitter

h2jitter <- ggplot(data=h2Data,
                  aes(x=commitmentavg,
                      y=attractimp))+ 
  labs(x="Confidence/Security in Relationship",
       y="Importance of Looking Attractive",
       title="Relationship between Security in Relationship and Importance of Looking Attractive")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)+
  geom_jitter(width=.12, height=.04, alpha=.04, size=.6)

h2jitter




```

## H2 - Smooth Line

```{r}
#Scatter Plot with line
h2Line <- h2jitter + geom_smooth(method = "lm")

h2Line

```

## Save figures

```{r saveFigures}
#Run after creating the plots. Save PNG files in the project's figures folder.

dir.create("figures",showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("figures/h1_figure_raincloud.png", plot=h1Rain, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

ggsave("figures/h2_figures_line.png", plot=h2Line, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

```
